name: Save discovery
description: Saves the pre-interview discovery profile for the caller's open interview and advances it to the topic-generation stage.

inputFields.label: Business unit
inputFields.description: The employee's department, business unit, or team.

inputFields.label: Focus topics
inputFields.description: Topics the employee considers most important to capture before they leave.

inputFields.label: Responsibilities
inputFields.description: The employee's core responsibilities and recurring tasks, in their own words.

inputFields.label: Role
inputFields.description: The departing employee's role or job title.

inputFields.label: Tools and systems
inputFields.description: Tools, systems, and applications the employee works with day to day.

inputFields.label: KPIs and constraints
inputFields.description: Optional. KPIs the employee owns and any constraints or dependencies worth recording. Send only when the employee provides them.
